title: TotemCrit
description: Adds a totem explosion effect whenever you land a critical hit.
body:
Bring some extra flair to your combat with Totem Critical Explosions!
This lightweight mod adds a special visual twist: whenever you land a critical hit, a totem explosion effect is triggered, making your strikes feel more powerful and rewarding.

Whether you’re fighting hostile mobs or clashing with other players, every crit now feels like a moment worth celebrating. The effect is purely visual, so it won’t affect game balance—just your style.

✨ Features

Totem explosion effect on every critical hit

Lightweight and performance-friendly

Works seamlessly in both singleplayer and multiplayer

💡 Credits
This mod was inspired by a fantastic idea and request from lxrens5950. Big thanks for sparking the concept!
